title: Amnesty International Defends US Regime-Change NGOs
author: Roger D. Harris - John Perry
content:
Why are many Latin American countries shutting down nonprofit organizations?
Amnesty International claims it has the answer: in every case, it’s part of a
drive to restrict human rights and “tear up the social fabric.” Amnesty’s new
95-page report (in Spanish, with an English summary), criticizes governments
across the political spectrum for attacking what it calls “civil society
organizations.” But Amnesty ignores the history of many such organizations and
therefore why governments might be justified in closing them.
